q: How do we calculate the carbon footprint of a lift irrigation scheme?
title: Lift irrigation scheme: emissions
short: Lift irrigation pumps water uphill, so electricity dominates. Multiply metered kWh at each pumping station by 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25, then divide by water delivered or hectares served. Pump efficiency and the height lifted drive the figure.
audience: Irrigation departments and water user groups

ul: kWh per pumping station from the meter.
Water delivered, in million cubic metres.

p: Efficient pumps, trimmed impellers and fewer leaks in rising mains cut kWh per cubic metre.

senseible: Senseible reads electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and diesel, LPG and gas invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a dated, fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record for each site. Intensity per unit uses the activity count you enter, and estimates are labelled as estimates.

sources.label: CEA CO2 Baseline Database for the Indian Power Sector
